policy: Canonical job rows should come from the employer's own public recruiting site or its explicitly public recruiting tenant. Third-party aggregators may help discover a company source but are not canonical when an official source is available.

sources.note: Campus semantics 201/202 are implemented and unit-tested, but the Python requests runtime received HTTP 405 in the live GitHub runner. Keep fallback official coverage until a browser/Node-compatible first-party transport is separately proven.
